# sskd.tech — Ilya Dyomin's blog

> A developer's blog about life, software, travel, and everything in between.
> Author: Ilya Dyomin, Software Developer from Kazakhstan.

## About

This site is a personal blog by Ilya Dyomin. Posts cover a broad range of topics:
- Software development (web, frontend, backend, DevOps, Kubernetes)
- Life in Kazakhstan and travels
- Productivity and life hacks
- Side projects and experiments

## Content

- /notes — All blog posts and notes
- /about — About the author
- /work — Projects and work experience

## Technical

- Site: https://sskd.tech
- Built with Astro 5 (SSR), React 19, Tailwind CSS
- Content managed via a custom headless CMS (NestJS backend)
- Sitemap: https://sskd.tech/sitemap-index.xml
